rawContent: @MPRnews Hi! Was just listening to the interview w/ conservative radio host who was a “never Trumper” & you said you assumed he would be a “never Moorer” as well - #NeverMoore would be better 😂 We should make that a thing. #MeToo

As a Minnesotan, I’m torn. I am saddened by Al Franken  stepping down - really liked him as a representative. However! I’m disappointed in his past behavior & proud of the women coming forward w/ their stories #MeToo #NeverMoore
